features: log(n,d,nlist), normalization, metric onehot; registry candidate/algorithm/device/dtype/approximate onehot and static sampling/threads with missing indicators; numeric-workload x candidate-descriptor interactions
numeric_label_rule: finite positive qps_at_r95 AND terminal_status==OK AND utility_supervised=true
negative_handling: keep terminal coverage; no zero QPS/log target; all registry candidates remain prediction candidates absent external static exclusion
scaler: weighted training-part-only mean and population std, zero std becomes1
M_selection: smallest family_macro full-registry oracle-inclusion LOWER BOUND >=0.90, else10; observed-subset inclusion is diagnostic only
strong_fixed_ranking: descending positive-label task coverage, then family-macro arithmetic mean of observed retained utility among covered tasks, then registry order; full-coverage candidates therefore precede incomplete ones
screen_tie: baseline-first then registry order; exact floating equality, no tolerance search
oracle_tie: any positive candidate with exactly maximum recorded qps counts as oracle inclusion
oracle_definition: maximum Recall-qualified utility in genuine registered portfolio; historical GPU backend unverified => oracle identity partially identified
oracle_inclusion_bounds: lower=observed valid winner included AND every unknown candidate included; upper=observed valid winner included OR at least one unknown included
gpu_faiss_prediction: retained in15 registry; receives shared metadata coefficients but has no direct trusted genuine-GPU supervision
metadata_binding: workload_id join to existing frozen V2_WORKLOAD_MATRIX; fill blank static metadata fields only; reject nonblank conflicts; never impute outcomes
